name: Fred Image Generation - Stage 1
description: A minimal one-image proof-of-generation using GPT Image 2.5 Flare with Fred's two approved Google Drive style references. It returns image data directly and does not persist jobs or use n8n Data Tables.

parameters.content:
# Stage 1 · Prove one image generation

One webhook request → two approved Google Drive reference images → OpenRouter Images API → image data returned to the caller.

GPT Image 2.5 Flare is called only through the dedicated image endpoint at low quality, 16:9, one image. This prototype has no AI planning, n8n Data Tables, database persistence, Sheets, or Drive upload. The Format Image Result node exposes both the data URL and a binary image preview for inspection.
